answer: Behavior fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk forgery. Each identity locks a 40 POA bond and must build a record over 20 epochs, like an orchard, not one island of copied trades. An honest agent pays once, passes one diversity check at the summit of its record, and earns undiluted rewards. An attacker with 100 fakes locks 4,000 POA, while a fake earns at most 20 POA before audit, so each fake loses 20 POA. Copied prints fail and burn the bond.
